entity.summary: Open-source self-custody cryptocurrency wallet from BitPay, available on mobile and desktop platforms.
entity.notes: Current first-party BitPay material explicitly describes BitPay Wallet as self-custody and available across iOS, Android and desktop. The company's 2011 founding date is not reused as the wallet launch date.

products.summary: BitPay self-custody wallet application distributed across mobile and desktop operating systems from the same wallet lineage.
products.notes: Treated as one multi-platform application product because current first-party material presents the same BitPay Wallet app and recovery phrase model across mobile and desktop.

events.title: BitPay Wallet added XRP buy, sell, and swap support
events.description: BitPay announced that XRP buying, selling, and swapping became available directly in the self-custody BitPay Wallet for eligible users, expanding existing XRP storage and spending support.

evidence.title: BitPay Wallet
evidence.notes: Current BitPay wallet page describes the wallet as open source and self-custody with user-controlled keys.

evidence.title: How to create a wallet using the BitPay app
evidence.notes: Current BitPay support confirms self-custody and current iOS, Android, Windows, macOS and Linux distribution.

evidence.title: Download the BitPay Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party BitPay download page distributes iOS and Android wallet builds and links active support, supporting current maintenance.

evidence.title: Buy, Sell, and Swap XRP: Now Available in the BitPay Wallet
